import sys, json, pathlib

from rcb_client import Robot
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image

def save(o,name):
    p=OUT/name;p.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    (p/'meta.json').write_text(json.dumps(o.meta,indent=2))
    for c,a in o.last.items():
        Image.fromarray(a).save(p/(c+'.png'))
    for c,a in o.depth.items():np.save(p/(c+'_depth.npy'),a)
    canvas=Image.new('RGB',(640,480))
    for i,c in enumerate(CAMS):
        if c in o.last:canvas.paste(Image.fromarray(o.last[c]),((i%2)*320,(i//2)*240))
    canvas.save(p/'views.png')
    print(json.dumps({'name':name,'proprio':o.meta.get('proprio'),'task':o.meta.get('task'),'time_left_s':o.meta.get('time_left_s')}))
    return o
if __name__=='__main__':
    (OUT/'spec.json').write_text(json.dumps(r.spec(),indent=2))
    save(r.get_obs(cameras=CAMS,include_depth=True),'initial')

def move(target,grip=-1,name='move',speed=.4):
    o=r.get_obs(cameras=[])
    p=np.array(o.meta['proprio']['now'])
    # Move by observed TCP error; settle before a small correction.
    delta=np.asarray(target)-p[:3]
    n=max(1,int(np.ceil(np.max(np.abs(delta))/(.01*speed))))
    a=np.zeros((n+30,4));a[:n,:3]=delta/(n*.01);a[:,3]=grip
    o=r.submit('ee_delta',a,dt=r.spec()['control_dt'],cameras=CAMS,include_depth=True,note=name)
    return save(o,name)

def hold(grip=1,n=60,name='hold'):
    a=np.zeros((n,4));a[:,3]=grip
    return save(r.submit('ee_delta',a,dt=.0125,cameras=CAMS,include_depth=True,note=name),name)
